name: Flyweight
summary: Uses sharing to support large numbers of fine grained objects efficiently, by separating the state that can be shared from the state that cannot.

roles.name: Flyweight
roles.summary: Declares the operations through which flyweights receive the state that is not shared.

roles.name: ConcreteFlyweight
roles.summary: A shareable flyweight: it holds only state that is independent of its context.

roles.name: UnsharedConcreteFlyweight
roles.summary: A flyweight that is deliberately not shared, although the interface allows sharing.

roles.name: FlyweightFactory
roles.summary: Creates and manages flyweights, and guarantees that shared ones are reused.
